Minecraft: Play with Friends!
Explore, build, craft together
$6.99 · In‑App Purchases

Dive into an open world of building, crafting and survival. Gather resources, survive the night, and build whatever you can imagine one block at a time. Explore and craft your way through a completely open world where you can play with friends, build a city, start a farm, mine deep into the ground, face mysterious enemies, or just experiment to the limits of your imagination!
The possibilities are endless. Embark on an epic adventure and play with friends, building from the ground up. Build and expand in Creative mode, where you can craft from unlimited resources. Survive the night, face intense battles, craft tools, and fend off danger in Survival mode. With seamless cross-platform and multiplayer gameplay on Minecraft: Bedrock Edition, you can adventure solo or with friends, and discover an infinite, randomly generated world filled with blocks to mine, biomes to explore, and mobs to befriend (or battle)!
In Minecraft, the world is yours to shape!
CREATE YOUR WORLD
• Build anything from the ground up
• Craft from special resources and tools to create brand new structures and landscapes
• Explore an endless open world full of different biomes and creatures
• Minecraft Marketplace – Get creator-made add-ons, thrilling worlds, and stylish cosmetics on Minecraft Marketplace
• Connect with millions of players on community servers, or subscribe to Realms Plus to cross-play with up to 10 friends on your own private server
• Slash commands – Tweak how the game plays: you can change the weather, summon mobs, change the time of day, and more
• Add-ons – Customize your experience even further with add-ons! If you're more tech-inclined, you can modify your game to create new resource packs
MULTIPLAYER ONLINE GAMES
• Join free massive multiplayer servers and play with thousands of others
• Multiplayer servers allow you to play with up to 4 players online with a free Xbox Live account
• Build, battle and explore other realms. With Realms and Realms Plus, you can play with up to 10 friends cross-platform, anytime, anywhere on Realms, your own private server that we host for you
• With Realms Plus, get instant access to over 150 Marketplace items with new additions each month. Share with friends on your own private Realms server\
• Connect and play with players across the world, wherever they are, and join in on MMO battles for survival in other worlds
• Discover gigantic community-run worlds, compete in unique mini-games and socialize in lobbies full of fellow Minecrafters

Editors’ Choice
If you can imagine it, you can create it—anything from monolithic towers to cavernous rollercoasters. That’s the idea that sparked a world-building phenomenon in Mojang’s amazing Minecraft. Since the game's release on the App Store, a steady stream of meaningful updates has kept this cube-filled universe fun, fresh and jam-packed with exciting features.

Best game ever
OK this is hands down one of if not the best game ever. It is fun, relaxing, and engaging and you can be very creative with what you do. There is endless freedom; you can make anything you want, you can create games with commands (there are sooo many it’s insane) and you can also make maps with those powers combined. And that’s just creative mode. Survival mode is more limited, you have to do way more to get your wanted results, but that just makes everything feel more rewarding! It’s also fun to play hardcore because it’s almost like real life (except for all of the dangerous monsters)! Redstone is also a very fun mechanic. You can make huge doors, automatic farms, and secret bases with the help of just a few components (and maybe a tutorial) all without commands! I’ve played this game for years and honestly the best device is computer (it’s easy to type, learn to play, Redstone is easier, you can do way more with commands) on Java edition. The worst device to play on is honestly any mobile device, especially phones (Redstone is harder, typing is still fast, commands are more basic, and it’s harder to build stuff in creative mode IMO) in bedrock. I think the differences between bedrock/pocket edition and Java edition make the game easier to play on different devices. Sorry for essay length review BTW. Ever since I started playing in 1.6 (?) I have enjoyed this game to its full extent, please do yourself a favor and get this game if you haven’t already!

Great game but.. (Mojang you better read this!)
Minecraft is a great game! My friend Alana (it’s not her real name) first told me about Minecraft whenever I met her for the first time when I moved to Oklahoma, and that was 6 years ago! Minecraft is a great game and I recommend it to anyone who loves making stuff or loves sonic or anything else! If you are looking forward to buying Minecraft on your device I really suggest you read this to hear about some of the things that are annoying, but the great things about Minecraft as well! The first thing that’s really annoying is with the camera, the camera will sometimes lag where your camera is all laggy and it’s hard to move. One time I was playing with my friend let’s call her Renae. We were playing together when my camera got all laggy and it was hard to move my characters head I was really annoyed by it. Also Minecraft will kick you out from the game for no freaking reason it’s really annoying when it happens. The cherry orchid biome, it’s supposed to have pink leaves, but in the game it has green leaves when the template picture shows pink leaves, so please fix that as well. But other than that Minecraft is a great game for example: They let you have an option to keep your inventory when you die in survival, but you have to have cheats enabled. Minecraft is just great! I really recommend it to anyone who absolutely loves building stuff and is very creative! I hope you all have a great time with Minecraft!Xoxo My Hero Academia lover, Chloe Slater. 💗 💗 💗 🥰 🥰 🥰

Awesome game but I have a few important things to say
I love Minecraft so much but I have a few things to say. First of all, I have seen some memes about the new update that brings the mob known as the “sniffer” to Minecraft being available to them, and the memes were made by regular people who aren’t famous. However, judging by the fact that my mobile phone - the device I use to play Minecraft on - has not updated Minecraft to the update that the memes I mentioned earlier in this review. This can not be due to bad Wi-Fi because the area in which my home is located has good Wi-Fi. Therefore, my conclusion as to why this problem is happening is because the latest Minecraft update has yet to be played on mobile devices. Also, creating a Microsoft account just to have fun with friends and family is unnecessary. It takes way too long to make a Microsoft account. I also feel that it would be risky. The risk of my personal data being stolen by a hacker or team of hackers would be somewhat low but still too high for me . The last thing I have to say in this review is a question. There is this game called MineTap that I love playing. You fight mobs every once in a while. A lot of them are basically redesigned mobs from Minecraft and Minecraft Dungeons, but some are original mobs that have not been in different games. Can those mobs that the creators of MineTap invented be used for MineTap merchandise? I love Minecraft so much that if you could give ratings of infinite stars, I would give it a rating of infinite stars!
